toml:
# Kshana lunar-infrastructure scenario: od-consistency with an unmodelled acceleration. MODELLED; the design, inputs and bars are
# fixed in xval/lunar-infra/PREREGISTRATION.md (committed before any run). ILLUSTRATIVE inputs
# are labelled with their public sources there.
kind = "lunar-infrastructure"
study = "od-consistency"
seed = 20261019

[orbit]
family = "nrho"
x0 = 1.0220
z0 = -0.1800
vy0 = -0.1020
arc_days = 3.0
sample_s = 600.0

[gnss]
altitude_km = 20180.0
inclination_deg = 55.0
planes = 6
sats_per_plane = 4
phasing_f = 2.0
tx_power_dbw = 13.4
tx_diameter_m = 0.35
tx_efficiency = 0.6
freq_hz = 1575.42e6
rx_gain_dbi = 12.0
system_temp_k = 290.0
tracking_threshold_dbhz = 25.0
dll_bn_hz = 0.25
sis_sigma_m = 1.0

[ground]
stations = ["DSS-14", "DSS-63", "DSS-43"]
range_sigma_m = 5.0
doppler_sigma_mm_s = 0.05
min_elevation_deg = 10.0
earth_rotation_phase_deg = 0.0

[monte_carlo]
trials = 400
model_error_accel_m_s2 = 3.0e-10
summary: lunar-infrastructure od-consistency: GNSS 351.5 m vs ground 23.0 m position sigma, mean q 5.95 (chi-square 6 expects 6)
